summary.zh: 标题入场：一排黑白线稿的压机依次砸下来，每砸一下就从料块里“压”出一个字——先被压扁，再按阻尼弹簧回到原形，旁边冒两团小烟。下面可以输入自己的词再压一遍，点任意一个字也能单独再压一次。
summary.en: A headline entrance: a row of line-drawn presses slam down one after another, each stamping a letter out of a block — squashed flat first, then springing back along a damped spring with a puff. Type your own word to press it again, or click any letter to re-press it.

technique.zh: 压头用 ease-in 加速砸下（150ms），停 60ms 再带一点过冲弹回去。字从 scaleY(0.48) 开始按阻尼弹簧回到 1：x(t)=1+(x₀−1)·e^(−ζωt)(cos ω_d t + ζω/ω_d·sin ω_d t)，采样成 30 个关键帧，scaleX = 1/√scaleY 保持体积。错峰每台 140ms，奇偶交替快慢一点点，听起来更像机器。
technique.en: Heads slam down with ease-in (150ms), dwell 60ms and spring back up with a little overshoot. Each letter starts at scaleY(0.48) and returns to 1 along a damped spring: x(t)=1+(x₀−1)·e^(−ζωt)(cos ω_d t + ζω/ω_d·sin ω_d t), sampled into 30 keyframes, with scaleX = 1/√scaleY to keep volume. 140ms stagger, alternating slightly faster/slower so it feels mechanical.

desc.zh: 每台压机之间错开多久
回弹阻尼比，越小弹得越久

adapt.zh: 适合活动页标题、欢迎语、空状态大字。中文、英文都能排；每个字是一个按钮，读屏会读整句。
adapt.en: For event headlines, welcome screens or big empty-state text. Works with Latin and CJK; each letter is a button and screen readers get the whole word.
